name: Hempmade - Cannabis Store & Chillin Hub/ 大麻店/ Weed Dispensary & Lounge
address: 1353/1 Sukhumvit Rd, Khwaeng Phra Khanong Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

reviews.text:
I’ve been visiting Hempmade for a couple of months now, and it’s quickly become my go-to spot in Bangkok. The experience here is truly one-of-a-kind. From the moment you walk in, the atmosphere is incredibly chill, and it’s clear that every detail has been thoughtfully crafted to make you feel at ease. While the PlayStation 5 is a fun touch, it’s really the entire experience — from the welcoming staff to the top-quality flower and everything in between — that makes this place stand out.

The cannabis selection is top-notch, and that's what keeps me coming back. Hempmade offers an array of unique, exotic, and handpicked Thai-grown strains that are a cut above the rest. Whether you’re a seasoned connoisseur or a curious newcomer, the quality of the flower speaks for itself. Each strain is carefully selected, offering distinct profiles that cater to all kinds of preferences.

But the experience doesn’t stop with the weed. Hempmade’s homemade Thai drinks and coffees perfectly complement the laid-back vibe, making it an even more enjoyable place to spend time. The space itself is laid out across four levels, each serving a different purpose. The ground floor is the main store, where you can check out their products. The second floor is a dedicated chill and smoke area, featuring a PlayStation 5 and a small balcony — an ideal spot for working or just unwinding. The third floor is used for storage, and the fourth floor features a rooftop area, with both an indoor lounge and a peaceful outdoor balcony that’s perfect for enjoying a smoke with a view.

What really makes Hempmade so special, though, is the people. The owner, Staz, and the employee, Golf, are some of the kindest and most knowledgeable individuals you’ll find in the industry. They’ve created an inviting, inclusive environment that’s perfect for everyone, whether you're a regular or just stepping in for the first time. Their passion for cannabis and customer care shines through in everything they do, and they’re always happy to offer expert recommendations or just chat about the strains they have in stock.

If you’re in Bangkok, whether you’re an experienced smoker or someone new to the scene, you absolutely need to check out Hempmade. From the quality of the cannabis to the overall vibe and atmosphere, it’s an experience you won’t find anywhere else. Drop by, say hello to Staz and Golf, and see for yourself why Hempmade is the best place to relax and enjoy great weed.

Absolutely loved my visit to Hempmade. The staff was incredibly knowledgeable and helped me find exactly what I was looking for. Since I live across town, I prefer to send Grab for convenience. However, the poor communication has made this process frustrating.
